records.title: Learning Cross-View Object Correspondence via Cycle-Consistent Mask Prediction
records.reason: Cross-view object correspondence task; no LLM/VLM inference-efficiency method.

records.title: Learning State-Tracking from Code Using Linear RNNs
records.reason: Linear RNN state tracking is studied on code/REPL-style interaction and synthetic permutation composition. Limitations say experiments omit realistic parsing, control flow and memory management; no LLM inference-efficiency improvement is established.

records.title: Integrating deep clustering and multi-view graph neural networks for recommender system
records.reason: Graph neural-network recommender; no LLM inference or serving method.

records.title: MoCo: A One-Stop Shop for Model Collaboration Research
records.reason: MoCo is an experimental framework for model collaboration, not a serving optimization. Evaluations report collaboration quality and analyze training/inference efficiency, but methods center on collaborative-model strategies; relationship to MoE/inference systems is plausible but indirect.

records.title: U-RWKV: Accurate and Efficient Volumetric Medical Image Segmentation via RWKV
records.reason: RWKV volumetric medical image segmentation; efficient sequence model, but no LLM inference method and application is medical image segmentation.
